I love capturing moments: a place I visited, a beautiful bit of nature, or even a plate of food that looks too good not to photograph.

Photography is my way of holding on to those moments, from everyday discoveries to new experiences. I’m a beginner sailor, still learning my way around it. I love being on or near water, and plenty of these photos reflect that. Back on land, I like to cook when the mood strikes, and baking is next on my list of things to try.
